author: Eve Luddington
quote: Simon explains everything so that a novice can understand, does an excellent job in good time and offers reasonable rates.

author: Denise Jeffries
quote: I have been going to Simon for years. Incredibly knowledgeable, professional and amicable. Their rates are the best you can find anywhere but the service is better than anywhere else.

author: Mick Gannon
quote: Great service with an honest approach to the customer. Had service and work done on our computer and more than pleased with the outcome. He goes out of his way to help and give great advice.
